scope: Continue the EXP43 validation-selected policies with the post-policy safety shield in the loop and collision event penalty 20. 500K x 3 seeds. Validation selection on collision-free rate (step 0 = EXP43 selected + shield is a candidate), sealed test once.
authorization: User 2026-10-02 midday: find a deep-RL method that clearly beats the traditional prior; auto-approve while away.
transition_unit: one environment control step, not individual robot samples
guidance_controller: route + observed particle repulsion prior with policy-controlled stop (residual RL)
comparability: Structured-policy track. Compared on the same sealed layouts to the prior alone and to EXP41.
task_limit: Controlled in-vitro goal-conditioned ideal-actuator simulation with perfect state. All object positions randomized on fixed MCA anatomy. Soft overlap costs, not hard collision physics. Diagnostic clearance feasibility is not collision-free policy performance or hardware verification.
dashboard_message: EXP45 安全护盾在环+碰撞惩罚20，续训 EXP43（非纯RL）。
study_stage: Formal 500K paired study; validation split for selection, sealed test (500 layouts) for the reported result.
bundled_variables: Shield in the training loop; collision event penalty 6 -> 20; parents are EXP43 selected checkpoints; 500K.

checkpoint_selection.rule: Pick the milestone with the highest collision-free clearance rate on the 200 registered validation layouts, ties broken by complete clearance then earlier milestone. Changed from EXP42 (complete clearance) because collision-free clearance is the metric with headroom.

sealed_test.report: Final claims use only sealed-test results; 940000000-940000099 is diagnostic only.
